answer: Each identity locks 60 in a vault: 45 bond, 15 fee. Each epoch has one unpredictable comet window. To keep it, it must show its thread of check-ins from that window, tied to its vault key and auditor-replayable. A missed window forfeits 45; the fee is lost. The kth fake pays 60, since check-ins cannot be copied and one operator cannot cover two threads, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and risk 45,000. A rental ring fails: rented check-ins carry the renter key, not the fake vault key, and replay exposes the mismatch. An honest agent pays 60 once and recovers 45 after one window.
